notes.title: September 24th, 2025 - Playtest Patch v0.4.4
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy gunslingers![/p][p][/p][p]We can’t thank y’all enough for your feedback on our playtest. Thanks to all your sharp eyes and quick wits, we’ve already fixed many bugs and added improvements based on your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]The playtest will officially be closing on October 8th so make sure to saddle up and share your thoughts in the [url="https://discord.gg/aTa9Q9Vd6q"]Tombwater Discord[/url] before then! All you need to do is click the "Join the Playtest" button on the store page for access.[/p][p][/p][h1]Patch Notes[/h1][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]New heavy weapon, "Hitchin' Post", added to shop at Tombwater Station.[/p][/*][*][p]New spell “Sculpture Garden” available in a previously unfinished basement in Canyon Settlement.[/p][/*][*][p]Key questgivers can now mark maps to indicate quest locations.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the respawn error when the gunslinger’s real body dies while possessing a skeleton with Wraith Shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced magnification/overlap of certain sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Catalina can no longer get stuck mid-dash during the Sewer fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can no longer shoot through the fence to kill the Raven Hunter early.[/p][/*][*][p]Dynamite now displays the correct inventory amounts when upgrading with Emmaline.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor lighting issues with a torch in the Wraith Shot temple.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issues with the Quickswap menu UI.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other Changes/Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added creaky SFX to the windmill interior in Canyon Settlement.[/p][/*][*][p]Added interactable signposts to certain crossroads to aid in navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly nerfed Big Clown enemies and the Acolyte guarding the Silverbolt spell eye.[/p][/*][*][p]The bell puzzle tent in the Circus now locks players in until the puzzle is solved.[/p][/*][*][p]Added visual cues in the Central District to aid navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some burnable bushes in Canyon Floor to require Wraith Shot, encouraging players to learn the ability instead of relying solely on fire spells.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Once again, a huge thanks for riding along with our playtest! If you’ve already played, we’d love for you to take another spin and let us know what you think of the new changes. Now is also a great time to invite a friend to the playtest and make sure you’re in our [url="https://discord.gg/aTa9Q9Vd6q"]Discord[/url]. We’re so excited for our launch on November 12th and for y’all to experience the full game. 
[/p][p]Stay safe and be wary of the madness.[/p][p][/p][p]- The Tombwater Team [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3308200/Tombwater/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Tombwater Playtest
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy Gunslingers,  We’re giddy to share that, as of today, the Tombwater playtest is open to everyone! All you need to do is click the "Join the Playtest" button on the store page for access and jump into our [u][url="https://discord.gg/SeGN6HqrTh"]Discord[/url][/u] to share your feedback.
[/p][p]Thank you for being among the first to explore Tombwater with all its danger, horror, combat, and madness! With our launch coming up on November 12, we are excited to hear from the community what we can improve in this final push. 

Please provide all feedback and discussion in the “#feedback” channel of the Tombwater [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/SeGN6HqrTh"]Discord[/url][/u] server. We’ll be there to answer any questions and respond to your comments along the way![/p][p][/p][p]Useful feedback may include: [/p][list][*][p][b]Onboarding[/b] - Was there anything you wish had been better explained? [/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay [/b]- What moments were the most engaging, frustrating, unexpected, etc…  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Mechanics[/b] - Were the controls easy to pick up?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Difficulty[/b] - How would you rate the difficulty to your expectations?[/p][/*][*][p][b]Navigation[/b] - How was the overall flow? Did you ever feel like the objectives were too unclear? [/p][/*][*][p][b]Atmosphere[/b] - Did you like the visuals, music, and larger story? [/p][/*][*][p][b]Technical[/b] - Any bugs or crashes to report? [/p][/*][*][p][b]Misc[/b] - Any other feedback you’d like to share? 
[/p][/*][/list][p]Well, are you chaps chapping to begin? Join the Tombwater [u][url="https://discord.gg/SeGN6HqrTh"]Discord[/url][/u], and follow us on [u][url="https://twitter.com/midwest_games"]Twitter[/url][/u], [u][url="https://www.instagram.com/tombwater"]Instagram[/url][/u], and [u][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@tombwater"]TikTok [/url][/u]for future news. Please also invite some fellow gunslingers and don’t forget to wishlist the game on Steam, it really helps us out. We appreciate your time and feedback in our final pushes.
[/p][p]Stay safe and be wary of the madness!
[/p][p]-The Tombwater Team[/p]

notes.title: Cowboy soulslike Tombwater gets a release date, and its cursed town ain't big enough for both you and some horrific hombres
notes.notes:
Yee-haw. Excuse me, I meant to say that wild west soulslike metroidvania Tombwater has walked into the saloon and ordered a release date. 'I'll have November 12th, 2025', it growled, while flashing its big iron at everyone in the watering hole to show it meant business.

Originally roaming the plains of Itch.io, this funky-looking game comes from Max Mraz, developer of Ocean's Heart and Bloodborne tribute Yarntown, and Jake Wagner. The duo have trained their six-shooters on Steam, where you can already find a demo to check out.

Read more

notes.title: Tombwater Weapons & Spells Reveal
notes.notes: [p]Howdy Gunslingers, [/p][p][/p][p]We wanted to give you a glimpse into the 50+ weapons, 40+ spells, and 40+ charms that Tombwater will offer to help you survive fast-paced combat, ghoulish beasts, and creeping madness. [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="WtTfP-AjPfg;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3][b]Melees Include:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Blood Rapier:[/b] Blade of an infamous alchemist who sought immortality. Restores a small amount of health on each hit. Weapon art: Employ a life-stealing slash, then quickly backstep.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cursed Pickaxe:[/b] Pickaxe weighed down with regrets of the dead and still alive alike. Weapon art: Call regretful visages in a swirl of smoke.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Anchor: [/b]A ship’s anchor. Only the modified grip suggests this was before used as a melee weapon. Slow, but its sharp edges pierce deeply for its weight. Weapon art: Throw anchor, then reel it back on its chain.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Streetlamp: [/b]A gas streetlamp uprooted from Tombwater’s streets, largely unmodified. Successive swings can create a small burst of flame. Weapon art: Gather motes of flame to swirl around in a ring.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bullwhip:[/b] Leather bullwhip. Has a long reach but requires precision. Deals extra damage when striking with the tip.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333082/9e6ffd3970c35a3592963daf72477bf51cc8f0e1.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Firearms Include:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Oilsprayer: [/b]Oddly modified oil can that sprays its contents. Of dubious utility, but foes covered in oil would have difficulty navigating fire.  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Edison Cannon: [/b]An experimental contraption based on designs by the gunsmith Medvedik. Fires a bolt of lightning after a brief charge. Can only be fired in a straight line, so take care to align your target.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gatling Gun: [/b]Gatling gun that fires many bullets in a slightly uncontrollable spread. Once mounted on a stagecoach, it is now cumbersome but potentially devastating. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Rattler:[/b] An experimental pistol that coats its bullets in rattlesnake venom. Each hit deals a significant amount of poison buildup.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Infernal Shotgun: [/b]Fires shells packed with an alchemical mixture that reacts with blood in its target’s body, inflicting fire damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333082/28cad7833bcefccca8e2c97fed622b0f2fffbafb.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Spells Include: [/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Ox Fist: [/b]Conjure a spectral ox to charge forward. notes.title: Tombwater Map Reveal
notes.notes:
[p]Howdy gunslingers! 
[/p][p]The folks at GamesRadar+ just featured our map reveal, giving the first peek at nearly the full scope of the game. Honestly, we were having so much fun that we didn’t quite realize how big the map was growing as we were building! [/p][p][/p][p]There are nearly 20 distinct biomes to progress through in a non-linear fashion, with a mix of areas you can explore at any time and others that you need to unlock by gaining an ability, procuring an item, or defeating a boss. At launch, Tombwater is estimated to take 20-25 hours of gameplay for completion. So, pack a canteen and some jerky and prepare to stay awhile! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333082/1eb5143bcbc8bb468869a8bf6ea4bdc9af67cb7d.png"][/img][/p][p]For context, the current demo explores the Spanish Fort, an experience that[b] shares only 5% of this extensive playable map.[/b]
[/p][p][b]Detailed Points of Interest[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Central District [/b]includes:[/p][list][*][p]Tombwater Station, a historical landmark under the care of Amos Armijo, who somehow maintains a safe haven from the town’s monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]A traveling circus is in town but beware, there is no shortage of clowns![/p][/*][*][p]The Argent Cathedral, a local behemoth offering sacred rituals and a congregation of aggressive acolytes. 
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Thistle Gulch [/b]includes:[/p][list][*][p]A vast expanse of scrubland before the mesa ruins. The area is dangerously filled with hungry coyotes, oversized spiders, and other indescribable creatures. [/p][/*][*][p]A gateway to Tombwater Lake, the source of Silverwater rumored to have made the townspeople unnaturally strong. [/p][/*][*][p]Thistle Ranch, an abandoned homestead, dotted with the bloated remains of cattle and shambling figures picking their way between the carcasses.[/p][/*][*][p]Its namesake thistles can grow thick and tall. Visitors will need to make sure they have found some way of creating fire to clear a path.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333082/d68504acb6ca6c6e07a3e200f4c37fd51c76afa2.png"][/img][/p][p]We’d love to have you in the loop on our social channels. You can follow the developer, Max Mraz, on [url="https://bsky.app/profile/maxmraz.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] and join the Midwest Games [url="https://discord.com/invite/c4RAeDZfuR"]Discord [/url]for ongoing game updates. 
[/p][p]Stay safe and be wary of the madness.[/p][p] - Tombwater Team [/p]

notes.title: Tombwater: Know Before You Go
notes.notes:
[i][h3]TRAVEL WARNING: Reports of violent townspeople, contagious madness, and eldritch beasts on the rise in the town of Tombwater.
[/h3][/i]
[b]Howdy Gunslingers![/b] While I’m just the humble proprietor of what is perhaps the finest general store West of the Great Plains, allow me to recommend the respectable town of Tombwater as a comfortable restin’ stop on your journeys.

Many of you are familiar with our prosperous silver mines or perhaps arrived by train to play our demo. Rest assured, Tombwater has so much more for you to explore, just make sure you’re prepared!

[b]Pack for A Pleasant Visit:[/b]
[list]
[*] Healing Flask: Don’t forget this necessary item to restore your HP when needed!  
[*] Lantern: A must have to explore through the viscous darkness of Tombwater’s tunnels and caves.
[*] Weapons: Beyond classic firearms, many visitors find an array of weaponry best suits their time here. 
[*] Spells, Charms and Potions: Pack lightly, there are plenty of hidden items to aid you in combat.
[*] Climbing Gear/Grappling Hook: If you don’t own gear, you may find some that others have left behind due to their… quick departure.
[/list]
[b]Know Before You Go:[/b]
[list]
[*] Our town is unfortunately plagued by deadly Eldritch beasts. 
[*] If you come across an open campfire, take some rest. You’ll need it.
[*] Stay fit as a fiddle by keepin’ an eye on your madness meter. 
[*] Ammo is hard to come across in Tombwater, so you may have to resort to other forms of attack, such as melees.
[*] You cannot leave. A curse traps everyone and everything in Tombwater. 
[/list]
Tombwater is a special town but there’s a madness spreadin’ far beyond our control. For any of you strongfolk who brave the demo, prepare yourself for the otherworldly journey that lies ahead, and, please, stop by Dusty Withers’ Wares and Sundries for your general store needs!

Much obliged, 
Dusty Withers

notes.title: May 14th, 2025 - Demo Patch v0.2.3
notes.notes:
Howdy gunslingers!

As you may have realized, Tombwater is a town enveloped in madness and evil. And we would be mad to not listen to your feedback! We have implemented a few changes and bug fixes that will improve the demo experience. If you have any feedback that is not listed here, please let us know in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3308200/discussions/]Steam Discussions tab[/url] or in the [url=https://discord.com/invite/c4RAeDZfuR]Midwest Games Discord.[/url] 

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Nerf for Blood Rain spell damage output
[*] Improvements for M/KB controls
[list]
[*] Changed "Attack" to Left Mouse
[*] Changed "Fire" to Right Mouse
[*] Changed "Wraith Shot" to Middle/Side Mouse
[*] Changed "Pause/Unpause" to ESC
[*] Changed "Cancel" to Tab/Backspace
[*] Arrow keys are now hard bound to navigation controls in addition to WASD (WASD can be rebound, Arrow keys cannot due to a limitation of the engine)
[*] Added a visible cursor to assist in aiming using the Mouse [/list] [/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the UI was displaying generic control prompts instead of Xbox/PS4 specific
[*] Fixed issue where firing the gun then rapidly changing screens can disable gun use
[*] Fixed issue where dying before picking up the Spanish Fort key causes the key to disappear
[*] Fixed unintended inputs for confirming purchases in a shop
[*] Fixed issue where the player can move during the class selection screen, resulting in re-triggering the cutscene and all kinds of funky issues
[/list]
We are grateful for all the support that we have received on the demo! Reminder, the demo is really just a small dungeon in the greater world. There is so much more freedom to roam in the overworld coming later this year. Stay safe out there. Avoid the madness.

- The Tombwater Team

notes.title: Try Lovecraftian Wild West soulslike Tombwater early, as new demo launches
notes.notes:
We may never get Bloodborne on PC, but we did get the excellent fan demake Yarntown, created by solo developer Max Mraz of Moth Atlas. Since then, Mraz has adapted and expanded that core concept to create Tombwater, a new, original soulslike that infuses Yharnam-style eldritch horror into a Wild West setting. If you're sad that Rockstar never gave Red Dead Redemption 2 its own version of Undead Nightmare, this exciting new Lovecraft-tinged action RPG might be the perfect salve, and you can try it for free on Steam right now.

Read the rest of the story...
